name: abi_lazy_peek
title: ABI: peek of an output ticks exactly once iff dirty
description: The 20-stage thermometer (out reads 2^n - 1 after n total ticks with clk held high) makes every hidden tick countable. Each poke arms the dirty flag; the first output peek after it must advance exactly one cycle, and further peeks none.
